Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Dimir Aqueduct, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2757-4222-7937.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.

Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.

Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Rofellos.
Repeat.

4872-5144-5913.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and exiling Ephemerate.
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.

Repeat step 1 two additional times.
Activate Trazyn using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

5344-5651-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5344-5651-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

2018-4050-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have flying.
2018-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with a flying counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.

Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the three Quasiduplicate copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.

When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and The Necrobloom trigger.

171-2526-3247-3258.notablePrerequisites:
"Dragons" chosen with Palace Siege.

At the beginning of your upkeep, Palace Siege and Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Palace Siege trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve the Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
